from pathlib import Path
folder = Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545741/attempts/24c6b32aa5ef47bea0ad877ddcf721da/system/state/workspace/programs')
folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program = '''from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    grid = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    groups = []
    r = 0
    while r < h:
        if all(v == background for v in grid[r]):
            r += 1
            continue
        start = r
        while r < h and any(v != background for v in grid[r]):
            r += 1
        groups.append((start, r))
    for i in range(len(groups)):
        a0, a1 = groups[i]
        for j in range(i + 1, len(groups)):
            b0, b1 = groups[j]
            if a1 - a0 != b1 - b0:
                continue
            count_a = sum(v != background for row in grid[a0:a1] for v in row)
            count_b = sum(v != background for row in grid[b0:b1] for v in row)
            if count_a == count_b:
                continue
            target, source = (a0, b0) if count_a < count_b else (b0, a0)
            for dr in range(a1 - a0):
                for c in range(w):
                    if grid[target + dr][c] == background and grid[source + dr][c] != background:
                        grid[target + dr][c] = 1
    return grid
'''
p = folder / 'task-1d139450.py'
p.write_text(program)
exec(compile(program, str(p), 'exec'))
# Demo 1: two one-row copies of the same horizontal feature; shorter one is marked.
d1 = [[4]*19 for _ in range(23)]
d1[0] = [5]*15 + [4]*4
d1[9] = [5]*19
out1 = transform(d1)
exp1 = [row[:] for row in d1]
exp1[0][15:19] = [1]*4
assert out1 == exp1
# Demo 2: repeated 6-row motif, with cells missing from the lower copy marked.
rows = [
[3,3,2,3,2,3,3,3,3,3,2,3,2,3],
[3,3,3,2,2,3,3,2,2,2,2,2,2,2],
[3,3,3,3,2,3,2,3,2,3,2,3,2,3],
[2,2,3,3,3,3,3,2,2,3,2,3,2,3],
[3,3,3,2,2,2,2,2,2,2,3,2,3,2],
[3,3,3,2,3,2,2,3,2,3,2,3,2,3],
]
d2 = [[2]*14 for _ in range(30)]
for k,row in enumerate(rows,1): d2[k] = row[:]
for k,row in enumerate(rows,20): d2[k] = row[:10] + [2]*4
out2 = transform(d2)
exp2 = [row[:] for row in d2]
for rr,cc in [(20,11),(20,13),(22,11),(22,13),(23,11),(23,13),(24,10),(24,12),(25,11),(25,13)]: exp2[rr][cc] = 1
assert out2 == exp2
# Test output
te = [[0]*25 for _ in range(22)]
te[8] = [9]*25
te[16] = [9]*20 + [0]*5
result = transform(te)
print('demo validations passed; test changed cells:', [(r,c,result[r][c]) for r in range(22) for c in range(25) if result[r][c] != te[r][c]])
